name: Electramatic
old_description: Electramatic is a contract manufacturer of electrical wire harness and electro-mechanical assembly that includes: Cutting, terminating, injection molding, twisting, braiding, soldering, marking and tubing services.
about:
Electramatic was founded in 1963 in Minneapolis, Minnesota, and operates a 40,000-square-foot facility in the city’s Northeast neighborhood. The company has grown steadily since its inception, expanding its footprint to support improved production flow and manufacturing processes.

As a contract manufacturer, Electramatic specializes in electrical wire harnesses and electro‑mechanical assemblies. Its capabilities include cutting, stripping, terminating, soldering, twisting, braiding, marking, tubing, injection molding, ultrasonic welding, and wire dyeing and striping. The shop handles wire from 30 AWG to 4/0 and offers engineering support for custom designs.

The company serves a broad range of industries, with over 80 customers that include commercial refrigeration and industrial genset harness manufacturers. Its client base spans the Midwest and beyond, reflecting a focus on responsive supply of cable assemblies.

Electramatic emphasizes quality and responsiveness. It is ISO 9001:2015 registered and follows the IPC/WHMA‑A‑620 standard, with defect‑per‑million and on‑time‑delivery metrics displayed on the production floor. The firm’s stated vision is to be the most responsive supplier of electrical cable assemblies in the Midwest, positioning itself as a proactive problem‑solver for complex assembly challenges.
